item.title: Tech Talks — Tue Sep 1, 3:30 PM — Montclair Main - Classroom
item.description:
Tech Talks is a free informational series where library staff introduce and explain the technology topics that matter most in today's digital world. Each session takes a closer look at a new or complex topic—whether it's a trending app, an emerging technology, or a platform you've been hearing about but aren't quite sure how to navigate. Through demonstrations and clear, jargon-free explanations, you'll come away with a better understanding of the tech landscape around you. There's no hands-on component, so no devices are needed—just come ready to learn and ask questions.
All are welcome regardless of experience level, and time is reserved at the end of each session for Q&A. Sessions are free and open to the public.

item.title: The First Birds of Autumn NEW — Wed Sep 2, 8:00 AM — Montclair - Offsite
item.description:
Note: This is a paid Adult School class. Click here to register.
We will visit a different site each week to witness the southbound migration of birds from as far away as Alaska and the Russian Far East. Vireos, warblers, and tanagers are among the songbirds likely to be seen in August and September, along with a good range of wading birds. Our destinations will be set shortly before each excursion, the choice determined by recent reports of concentrations of migrants.

item.title: Let's Walk!! Brookdale Park — Sat Aug 8, 9:30 AM
item.description:
Let's Walk!! If entering from Bellevue Avenue and park in the first parking lot on the left. We will be gathering near the the playground area.
if entering from Watchung Ave, park and walk up to the upper parking lot near the playground area.
We will be walking the outer path. There are several break-off points if you do not want to walk the entire path.
The walk will be about an hour or at least 3-4 miles.
Wear comfortable shoes!
Please plan to arrive 5 minutes early. The walk will start promptly.
Brookdale Park offers the public access to both passive and active recreational activities as well as picturesque vistas. Trails for walking and running, lush groves and extensive lawns, playgrounds, sports fields, track facilities, tennis courts, an archery range and stadium grandstand are just some of the numerous attractions that make Brookdale Park a magnet for nature lovers, families, and physical fitness enthusiasts for miles around.
https://www.essexcountyparks.org/parks/brookd

item.title: 80's Summer Movie Series — Sun Aug 9, 2:00 PM — Bellevue Theatre
item.description: Step back into the 80s! To celebrate their 40-year reunion, the Montclair High School Class of 1986 is bringing four classic films back to the big screen at the historic Bellevue Theatre. The Lineup (Sundays at 2:30 PM / Doors at 2:00 PM): July 26: Trading Places August 9: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom August 30: Footloose September 13: Ferris Bueller’s Day Off The Cause: Proceeds support the MHS Class of 1986 Scholarship, administered through the Montclair Scholarship Fund. Created entirely through alumni donations, the Class of 1986 is proudly one of only two MHS graduating classes to establish a named, class-specific scholarship, supporting graduating Mounties for more than a decade. Tickets: $30 (includes popcorn!). Note: Seating is limited, and tickets must be purchased in advance online—none will be sold at the door. item.title: Simple Sitting Meditation (15 minutes) — Wed Aug 12, 11:00 AM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream In these sessions, I will be doing guided meditations where we simply sit and notice what arises.
There is no agenda and no plan for how these sessions unfold. I might start off simply by asking us to notice what is already present. By becoming aware of what’s going on in our heads and in our body.
Then, the meditation may take on a life of its own.
Our job is to simply be present to what arises. We may notice the mind moving and chattering about. Or we may notice that it’s completely silent.
The goal here, if there is one, is to simply let ourselves be as we are.
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: Eagle Rock Reservation — Fri Oct 30, 9:15 AM
item.description:
Let's Walk!! JOIN US FOR A WALK. WE WALK AT A MODERATE PACE ON UNPAVED PATHS.
We will hike for about an hour - 3.5 miles. We will be walking on trails in the woods, so appropriate footwear, long pants & socks, and bug spray.
Will will meet at: [https://goo.gl/maps/7rRRTiXCntdE1neD7](https://goo.gl/maps/7rRRTiXCntdE1neD7) Eagle Rock Trail Parking Lot by Kiosk#1
If you enter from Eagle Rock Way, go pass the Highlawn and stay left. There will be a parking lot at the end of the curve to your right.
Eagle Rock Reservation is 408 acres of hills, streams, and valleys located on the borders of West Orange, Verona, and Montclair, New Jersey. Though located in the middle of the most densely populated county in the most densely populated state in the country, the Reservation is mostly undeveloped and boasts an extensive trail system within its borders.
**Please make sure to RSVP and arrive 5 minutes prior to start time.**

item.title: Celebration: the Art of Catherine Kinkade — Fri Aug 7, 1:00 PM — Leach Gallery
item.description: Studio Montclair announces a very special exhibition, “Celebration: the Art of Catherine Kinkade”. This exhibition and fundraiser in support of Studio Montclair, in partnership with BrassWorks Gallery, will be showing in two locations. It will run from August 7 to 23 at Studio Montclair’s Leach Gallery, 641 Bloomfield Avenue, Montclair, NJ, and through August 28 at BrassWorks Gallery, 105 Grove Street, Montclair. An Opening Reception will take place on Friday, August 7 – starting at BrassWorks Gallery from 4 to 6pm, continuing at SMI’s Leach Gallery from 6 to 8pm. All are welcome. “Celebration: the Art of Catherine Kinkade” is a memorial exhibition and fundraiser celebrating the life and work of Catherine Kinkade – a painter of extraordinary feeling, a generous and devoted teacher, and one of the most warmly cherished figures in the Montclair arts community for nearly four decades. item.title: Awakening Awareness: Embracing This Moment — Tue Aug 11, 9:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream Feel free to join as we get still and practise presence within this moment. We will discuss and observe the obstacles that, seemingly, block us from being present and bring awareness to our unconsciousness in a safe, inclusive and affirming way.
Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teaching and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous.
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys has been passionate about mindfulness since 2010 and since 2021 he has been organising free, weekly online meditation groups. For more information on his free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group, visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/).

item.title: NJ Code & Coffee - September meetup — Sat Sep 19, 2:00 PM
item.description:
NJ Code & Coffee Calling all New Jersey techies to the monthly **NJ Code and Coffee** tech community meetup at the EqualSpace ES550 Tech & Innovation campus!
Code and Coffee is an inclusive, informal networking/co-working session for those in tech (and the tech-curious). That includes operators, founders, and investors. Developers, data engineers, UX/UI designers, data scientists, product managers, software engineers, solution architects... **all are welcome!**
People of all skill and experience levels can attend, we love it that way. Many people (optionally) bring projects to work on, and many other people (optionally) socialize the entire time. It's entirely up to you!
Come grab a cup of coffee and meet new people, share stories, find collaborators, talk about everything tech, talk about everything NOT tech, take a break from job applications, get away from the computer screen, make connections, make conversation, **make friends!**
